app.title: Quiz App
home.title: Choose a quiz module

modules.atlas.name: Atlas
modules.atlas.description: A playful world map quiz with countries and capitals.
atlas.title: Atlas
atlas.description: The Atlas module is wired up with routing, languages, and placeholder content.
atlas.placeholderBody: Category selection, maps, quiz logic, and results land in the next phase.
atlas.placeholderBulletTwo: Explore the map with zoom and pan
atlas.homeDescription: Pick a mode, region, and question count, then jump straight into a playful globe challenge.
atlas.categoryHint: Choose what you want to find on the map.
atlas.categoryCountriesDescription: Click the correct country shape on the map.
atlas.categoryCapitalsDescription: Drop a pin where the capital city belongs.
atlas.regionHint: Zoom in on a continent or play the whole world.
atlas.questionCountAllDescription: Use every available question in the region.
atlas.questionCountUnavailable: Not enough questions in this region.
atlas.attemptsHint: Countries can offer a helpful second shot.
atlas.attemptTwoDescription: One hint-powered retry for each miss.
atlas.summaryCountriesOneAttempt: One miss ends the question immediately — sharp and speedy.
atlas.summaryCountriesTwoAttempts: A first miss reveals a glowing hint, then you get one more try.
atlas.summaryCapitals: Place one pin per question and compare it with the real capital.
atlas.countryPromptBody: Click or tap the matching country on the map.
atlas.countryTwoAttemptsHint: Two-try mode is active — a first miss lights up the target area.
atlas.feedbackCountryPendingBody: Tap the country when you have spotted it.
atlas.feedbackCountryCorrectBody: That country was right on target.
atlas.feedbackCountryTryAgainBody: The highlighted glow shows the right answer. Try
atlas.feedbackCapitalPendingBody: Drop your pin anywhere on the map to lock in a guess.
atlas.mapAriaLabelCapitals: World map for placing capital pins
atlas.map.status.pickCountry: Pick a country by clicking or tapping the map. Dragging pans the map and will not submit an answer.
atlas.map.status.pickCountryDisabled: Country picking is locked. Use the map to inspect the answer and the zoom controls to explore.
atlas.map.status.placePin: Place a pin by clicking or tapping the map. Dragging pans the map and will not place a pin.
atlas.map.status.placePinDisabled: Pin placement is locked. You can still pan and zoom to inspect the result.
atlas.map.status.view: View mode. Hover a country to reveal its name, and use the zoom controls to explore the map.
